entry_points.name: Physical Device
entry_points.description: Physical access to the medical device, appliance, workstation, embedded hardware, or its enclosure.

entry_points.name: Local User Interface
entry_points.description: On-device or locally attached interfaces used by clinicians, operators, technicians, or patients.

entry_points.name: Sensor / Acquisition Interface
entry_points.description: Sensors, imaging inputs, physiological signals, acquisition hardware, and device-to-sensor communication paths.

entry_points.name: Clinical Network
entry_points.description: Hospital, clinic, laboratory, or other healthcare delivery networks to which the product connects.

entry_points.name: EHR / PACS / LIS Interface
entry_points.description: Interfaces to clinical information systems including EHR, PACS, RIS, LIS, and related interoperability services.

entry_points.name: Cloud API / Backend
entry_points.description: Internet-facing or private APIs, cloud services, databases, processing services, and backend infrastructure.

entry_points.name: Web / Mobile Application
entry_points.description: Browser-based, mobile, tablet, or companion applications used to access product functionality or data.

entry_points.name: Identity / Authentication
entry_points.description: Login, SSO, identity-provider, credential, token, session, authorization, and account-recovery interfaces.

entry_points.name: Software / Firmware Update
entry_points.description: Mechanisms used to distribute, verify, install, activate, or roll back software, firmware, configuration, or model updates.

entry_points.name: Third-Party Software / Library
entry_points.description: Third-party packages, libraries, operating-system components, containers, SDKs, and other incorporated software dependencies.

entry_points.name: Vendor / Supply Chain
entry_points.description: External vendors, development partners, manufacturers, service providers, build systems, and upstream supply-chain processes.

entry_points.name: Data Import / File Interface
entry_points.description: Files, removable datasets, uploads, exports, DICOM objects, documents, configuration files, and other imported data.

entry_points.name: Model / Training Data Pipeline
entry_points.description: Training, fine-tuning, validation, labeling, feature engineering, model registry, and training-data ingestion pipelines.

entry_points.name: Administrative / Support Interface
entry_points.description: Privileged administration, maintenance, remote support, diagnostics, service tooling, and operational management interfaces.

entry_points.name: Removable Media / Peripheral
entry_points.description: USB devices, external storage, serial devices, printers, displays, and other locally connected peripherals.

entry_points.name: External AI / Model Service
entry_points.description: Externally hosted AI, foundation-model, inference, embedding, decision-support, or other model-as-a-service dependencies.
